parentTitle: The Tied Arm That Proved Your Blood Circulates
status: STOP for Ben pick. Proposed only. Nothing to Studio.
factLock: Tight linen band on the upper arm; red (artery) only on the shoulder side, a wide glowing artery under the skin, stopping at the band; no red below it; forearm and hand paler below the band (De Motu Cordis ch. 11, FACT_NOTES_v01 row 26).
